question: What is the smallest positive number written using only the digits 0 and 1 that is divisible by 7?
solution: Check in increasing order: 1, 10, 11, 100, 101, 110, 111, 1000 leave 1, 3, 4, 2, 3, 5, 6, 6 on division by 7. 1,001 = 7 × 143 is the first multiple.
questionHi: केवल अंकों 0 और 1 से लिखी वह सबसे छोटी धनात्मक संख्या कौन-सी है जो 7 से विभाज्य हो?

subject: Maths
question: A number is written using only the digit 1 (11, 111, 1111, ...). What is the smallest number of 1s for it to be divisible by 33?
solution: 33 = 3 × 11. For 3 the digit sum (the number of 1s) must be a multiple of 3; for 11 the alternate sums must be equal, so the number of 1s must be even. The smallest count that is both is 6 (111,111 = 33 × 3,367).
questionHi: एक संख्या केवल अंक 1 से लिखी है (11, 111, 1111, ...)। 33 से विभाज्य होने के लिए उसमें कम से कम कितने 1 होने चाहिए?
solutionHi: 33 = 3 × 11। 3 के लिए अंकों का योग (1 की संख्या) 3 का गुणज हो; 11 के लिए एकांतर योग बराबर हों, अतः 1 की संख्या सम हो। दोनों शर्तें पूरी करने वाली सबसे छोटी संख्या 6 (111,111 = 33 × 3,367)।

subject: Maths
question: If the seven-digit number 3a3a3a3 is divisible by 11, what is the value of a?
solution: The four 3s sit in the odd places and the three a's in the even places: 12 − 3a must be 0 or a multiple of 11. 3a = 12 gives a = 4 (3,434,343 = 11 × 312,213); 3a = 1 or 23 gives no digit.
questionHi: यदि सात अंकों की संख्या 3a3a3a3, 11 से विभाज्य है, तो a का मान क्या है?

subject: Maths
question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 100 is n² + 1 divisible by 10?
solution: n² + 1 ends in 0 exactly when n² ends in 9, i.e. when n ends in 3 or 7. From 1 to 100 there are 10 of each: 20.
questionHi: 1 से 100 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए n² + 1, 10 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: n² + 1 का अंतिम अंक 0 तभी जब n² का अंतिम अंक 9, यानी n का अंतिम अंक 3 या 7। 1 से 100 में दोनों के 10-10: 20।

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest positive multiple of 9 whose digits are all even?
solution: Even digits add to an even number, so the digit sum must be 18 (not 9). Two even digits add to at most 16, so three digits are needed; the smallest three even digits adding to 18 in increasing order are 2, 8, 8: 288 = 9 × 32.
questionHi: 9 का वह सबसे छोटा धनात्मक गुणज कौन-सा है जिसके सभी अंक सम हों?
solutionHi: सम अंकों का योग सम होता है, अतः अंकों का योग 18 हो (9 नहीं)। दो सम अंकों का योग अधिकतम 16, अतः तीन अंक चाहिए; 18 जोड़ने वाले सबसे छोटे तीन सम अंक बढ़ते क्रम में 2, 8, 8: 288 = 9 × 32।

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest power of 5 that divides 200! (the product 1 × 2 × ... × 200)?
solution: Count the factors of 5: 200 ÷ 5 = 40 multiples of 5, 200 ÷ 25 = 8 multiples of 25 (one more each), 200 ÷ 125 = 1 multiple of 125 (one more). 40 + 8 + 1 = 49, so 5⁴⁹.
questionHi: 200! (गुणनफल 1 × 2 × ... × 200) को विभाजित करने वाली 5 की सबसे बड़ी घात कौन-सी है?

subject: Maths
question: How many numbers from 1 to 1,000 have no factor in common with 30 other than 1?
solution: Such a number is divisible by none of 2, 3 and 5. Divisible by at least one: 500 + 333 + 200 − (166 + 100 + 66) + 33 = 734. So 1,000 − 734 = 266.
questionHi: 1 से 1,000 तक कितनी संख्याओं का 30 के साथ 1 के अतिरिक्त कोई उभयनिष्ठ गुणनखंड नहीं है?

subject: Maths
question: How many six-digit numbers that use each of the digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 exactly once are divisible by 11?
solution: The three digits in odd places and the three in even places add to 21 in all, so their difference is odd and cannot be 0. To be ±11 one group would need to add to 16 and the other to 5, but three different digits from 1 to 6 add to at least 6. So none: 0.
questionHi: अंकों 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 और 6 में से हर एक को ठीक एक बार प्रयोग करने वाली छह अंकों की कितनी संख्याएँ 11 से विभाज्य हैं?
solutionHi: विषम स्थानों के तीन और सम स्थानों के तीन अंकों का कुल योग 21, अतः उनका अंतर विषम है, 0 नहीं हो सकता। ±11 के लिए एक समूह का योग 16 और दूसरे का 5 चाहिए, पर 1 से 6 के तीन भिन्न अंकों का योग कम से कम 6। अतः कोई नहीं: 0।

subject: Maths
question: How many four-digit numbers divisible by 99 have a digit sum of 18?
solution: There are 91 four-digit multiples of 99 (99 × 11 = 1,089 to 99 × 101 = 9,999). Each has digit sum 18 or 36 (it is a multiple of 9, and its two-digit blocks add to 99 or 198). Only 9,999 has 36. So 91 − 1 = 90.
questionHi: 99 से विभाज्य चार अंकों की कितनी संख्याओं के अंकों का योग 18 है?

subject: Maths
question: By which of the following is 3²⁰²⁵ + 5²⁰²⁵ divisible?
solution: For odd n, aⁿ + bⁿ is divisible by a + b = 8. It is not divisible by 3 (3²⁰²⁵ is, 5²⁰²⁵ is not) or by 5 (likewise). On division by 7, 3²⁰²⁵ and 5²⁰²⁵ both leave 6; 6 + 6 = 12 leaves 5, so not by 7.
questionHi: 3²⁰²⁵ + 5²⁰²⁵ निम्नलिखित में से किससे विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: विषम n के लिए aⁿ + bⁿ, a + b = 8 से विभाज्य है। 3 से नहीं (3²⁰²⁵ है, 5²⁰²⁵ नहीं) और 5 से भी नहीं (इसी तरह)। 7 से भाग पर 3²⁰²⁵ और 5²⁰²⁵ दोनों का शेष 6; 6 + 6 = 12 का शेष 5, अतः 7 से नहीं।

subject: Maths
question: A six-digit number is formed by writing a three-digit number twice (like 237,237). How many such numbers are divisible by 9?
solution: abcabc = abc × 1,001, and 1,001 = 7 × 11 × 13 has no factor 3. So abcabc is divisible by 9 exactly when abc is. There are 100 three-digit multiples of 9 (108 to 999).
questionHi: तीन अंकों की संख्या को दो बार लिखकर छह अंकों की संख्या बनाई जाती है (जैसे 237,237)। ऐसी कितनी संख्याएँ 9 से विभाज्य हैं?
solutionHi: abcabc = abc × 1,001, और 1,001 = 7 × 11 × 13 में 3 नहीं। अतः abcabc, 9 से तभी विभाज्य जब abc हो। 9 के तीन अंकों के 100 गुणज (108 से 999)।

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest n for which n! is divisible by 10⁶?
solution: n! needs six factors of 5 (twos are plentiful). 5, 10, 15, 20 give one each (4), and 25 gives two: by 25! there are 6. 24! has only 4. So n = 25.
questionHi: वह सबसे छोटा n कौन-सा है जिसके लिए n!, 10⁶ से विभाज्य है?

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest four-digit number with all digits different that is divisible by 72?
solution: Go down the multiples of 72 from 9,936: 9,936 repeats 9, 9,864 = 72 × 137 has all digits different. So 9,864.
questionHi: भिन्न अंकों वाली चार अंकों की वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है जो 72 से विभाज्य हो?

subject: Maths
question: How many numbers from 1 to 1,000 are divisible by exactly one of 2, 3 and 5?
solution: With A = 500, B = 333, C = 200, pairwise 166, 100, 66 and all three 33: exactly one = (A + B + C) − 2(pairs) + 3(all) = 1,033 − 664 + 99 = 468.
questionHi: 1 से 1,000 तक कितनी संख्याएँ 2, 3 और 5 में से ठीक एक से विभाज्य हैं?

subject: Maths
question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 100 is 2ⁿ + 1 divisible by 7?
solution: Powers of 2 leave only 2, 4 and 1 on division by 7, so 2ⁿ + 1 leaves 3, 5 or 2 - never 0. So no value of n works: 0.
questionHi: 1 से 100 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए 2ⁿ + 1, 7 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: 2 की घातों के 7 से शेष केवल 2, 4 और 1, अतः 2ⁿ + 1 के शेष 3, 5 या 2 - कभी 0 नहीं। अतः कोई n नहीं: 0।

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest five-digit number with all digits different that is divisible by 72?
solution: The multiples of 72 from 10,008 up: 10,008, 10,080, 10,152, 10,224 repeat a digit; so do the next few; 10,296 = 72 × 143 is the first with all digits different.
questionHi: भिन्न अंकों वाली पाँच अंकों की वह सबसे छोटी संख्या कौन-सी है जो 72 से विभाज्य हो?

subject: Maths
question: How many four-digit numbers that use each of the digits 1, 2, 3 and 4 exactly once are divisible by 11?
solution: The digits add to 10, so the two in odd places must add to 5 and the two in even places to 5: {1, 4} and {2, 3}. Either pair can take the odd places (2 ways), and each pair can be ordered in 2 × 2 ways: 2 × 4 = 8.
questionHi: अंकों 1, 2, 3 और 4 में से हर एक को ठीक एक बार प्रयोग करने वाली चार अंकों की कितनी संख्याएँ 11 से विभाज्य हैं?
solutionHi: अंकों का योग 10, अतः विषम स्थानों के दो अंकों का योग 5 और सम स्थानों के दो का 5: {1, 4} और {2, 3}। कोई भी जोड़ा विषम स्थान ले सकता है (2 तरह), और हर जोड़ा 2 × 2 तरह से: 2 × 4 = 8।

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest power of 12 that divides 40!?
solution: 12 = 2² × 3. 40! has 20 + 10 + 5 + 2 + 1 = 38 twos, enough for 19 fours, and 13 + 4 + 1 = 18 threes. The threes run out first, so 12¹⁸.
questionHi: 40! को विभाजित करने वाली 12 की सबसे बड़ी घात कौन-सी है?

subject: Maths
question: Which of the following divides 2⁶⁰ − 1?
solution: 61 is prime, so 2⁶⁰ leaves 1 on division by 61 (Fermat) and 2⁶⁰ − 1 is divisible by 61. For 23, 17 and 19, 2⁶⁰ leaves 9, 16 and 7, not 1.
questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 2⁶⁰ − 1 को विभाजित करता है?
solutionHi: 61 अभाज्य है, अतः 2⁶⁰ का 61 से शेष 1 (फ़र्मा) और 2⁶⁰ − 1, 61 से विभाज्य। 23, 17 और 19 से 2⁶⁰ के शेष 9, 16 और 7, 1 नहीं।

subject: Maths
question: For how many choices of the digits a, b and c is the six-digit number 5a1b2c divisible by 792?
solution: 792 = 8 × 9 × 11. For 9: 8 + a + b + c is a multiple of 9, so a + b + c = 1, 10 or 19. For 11: (5 + 1 + 2) − (a + b + c) = 8 − (a + b + c) must be 0 or −11, so a + b + c = 8 or 19. Together: a + b + c = 19. For 8: b2c must be a multiple of 8. The (b, c) that work and leave a = 19 − b − c a digit are (9, 8), (7, 8), (5, 8), (3, 8), (8, 4) and (6, 4): 6 choices (for example 521,928 = 792 × 659).
questionHi: अंकों a, b और c के कितने चयनों के लिए छह अंकों की संख्या 5a1b2c, 792 से विभाज्य है?

question: What is the smallest positive number written using only the digits 0 and 1 that is divisible by 12?
solution: 12 = 4 × 3. For 4 the number must end in 00 (10 is not a multiple of 4). For 3 the number of 1s must be a multiple of 3. The smallest is 11,100 = 12 × 925.
questionHi: केवल अंकों 0 और 1 से लिखी वह सबसे छोटी धनात्मक संख्या कौन-सी है जो 12 से विभाज्य हो?

subject: Maths
question: A number is written using only the digit 1. What is the smallest number of 1s for it to be divisible by 99?
solution: 99 = 9 × 11. For 9 the number of 1s (the digit sum) must be a multiple of 9; for 11 it must be even. The smallest number that is both is 18.
questionHi: एक संख्या केवल अंक 1 से लिखी है। 99 से विभाज्य होने के लिए उसमें कम से कम कितने 1 होने चाहिए?
solutionHi: 99 = 9 × 11। 9 के लिए 1 की संख्या (अंकों का योग) 9 का गुणज हो; 11 के लिए सम हो। दोनों शर्तें पूरी करने वाली सबसे छोटी संख्या 18।

subject: Maths
question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 100 is n³ + 1 divisible by 7?
solution: Cubes leave only 0, 1 or 6 on division by 7, and n³ leaves 6 exactly when n leaves 3, 5 or 6. From 1 to 100 each of these happens 14 times: 42.
questionHi: 1 से 100 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए n³ + 1, 7 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: घन 7 से केवल 0, 1 या 6 शेष छोड़ते हैं, और n³ का शेष 6 तभी जब n का शेष 3, 5 या 6। 1 से 100 में ये तीनों 14-14 बार: 42।

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest n for which n! is divisible by 7³?
solution: n! needs three factors of 7. They come from 7, 14 and 21, so the smallest n is 21. (20! has only two.)
questionHi: वह सबसे छोटा n कौन-सा है जिसके लिए n!, 7³ से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: n! में 7 के तीन गुणनखंड चाहिए। ये 7, 14 और 21 से आते हैं, अतः सबसे छोटा n = 21। (20! में केवल दो।)

subject: Maths
question: How many five-digit numbers that use each of the digits 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 exactly once are divisible by 4?
solution: The last two digits must be a multiple of 4 made of two different digits from 1 to 5: 12, 24, 32 or 52. For each, the other three digits can be arranged in 3! = 6 ways: 4 × 6 = 24.
questionHi: अंकों 1, 2, 3, 4 और 5 में से हर एक को ठीक एक बार प्रयोग करने वाली पाँच अंकों की कितनी संख्याएँ 4 से विभाज्य हैं?
solutionHi: अंतिम दो अंक 1 से 5 के दो भिन्न अंकों से बना 4 का गुणज हों: 12, 24, 32 या 52। हर एक के लिए बाकी तीन अंक 3! = 6 तरह से: 4 × 6 = 24।

subject: Maths
question: Every six-digit number that reads the same backwards (like 425,524) is divisible by:
solution: In abccba the digits in odd places are a, c, b and in even places b, c, a: the sums are equal, so it is always divisible by 11. 100,001 = 11 × 9,091 shows that 7, 13 and 101 need not divide it.
questionHi: उलटा पढ़ने पर भी वही रहने वाली हर छह अंकों की संख्या (जैसे 425,524) किससे विभाज्य होती है?
solutionHi: abccba में विषम स्थानों के अंक a, c, b और सम स्थानों के b, c, a: योग बराबर, अतः सदैव 11 से विभाज्य। 100,001 = 11 × 9,091 दिखाता है कि 7, 13 और 101 आवश्यक नहीं।

subject: Maths
question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 100 is 3ⁿ + 1 divisible by 13?
solution: 3³ = 27 leaves 1 on division by 13, so powers of 3 leave only 3, 9 and 1. Then 3ⁿ + 1 leaves 4, 10 or 2 - never 0. So no n works: 0.
questionHi: 1 से 100 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए 3ⁿ + 1, 13 से विभाज्य है?
solutionHi: 3³ = 27 का 13 से शेष 1, अतः 3 की घातों के शेष केवल 3, 9 और 1। तब 3ⁿ + 1 के शेष 4, 10 या 2 - कभी 0 नहीं। अतः कोई n नहीं: 0।

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest five-digit number with all digits different that is divisible by 99?
solution: Going down the multiples of 99 from 99,990: every one down to 98,802 repeats a digit, and 98,703 = 99 × 997 is the first with all digits different.
questionHi: भिन्न अंकों वाली पाँच अंकों की वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है जो 99 से विभाज्य हो?
solutionHi: 99,990 से नीचे 99 के गुणज देखें: 98,802 तक हर एक में कोई अंक दोहराया है, और 98,703 = 99 × 997 पहला जिसके सभी अंक भिन्न।

subject: Maths
question: How many numbers from 1 to 2,000 are divisible by at least one of 2, 3, 5 and 7?
solution: Count the rest - numbers sharing no factor with 210 = 2 × 3 × 5 × 7. Every block of 210 consecutive numbers holds 48 of them; 1 to 1,890 is 9 blocks (432), and 1,891 to 2,000 holds 26 more: 458. So 2,000 − 458 = 1,542.

question: What is the largest power of 2 that divides 50!?
solution: Count the factors of 2: 25 even numbers, 12 multiples of 4, 6 of 8, 3 of 16 and 1 of 32 each add one: 25 + 12 + 6 + 3 + 1 = 47. So 2⁴⁷.

subject: Maths
question: What is the largest power of 6 that divides 30!?
solution: 6 = 2 × 3. 30! has 15 + 7 + 3 + 1 = 26 twos but only 10 + 3 + 1 = 14 threes. The threes run out first, so 6¹⁴.
questionHi: 30! को विभाजित करने वाली 6 की सबसे बड़ी घात कौन-सी है?

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest positive number written using only the digits 0 and 1 that is divisible by 45?
solution: 45 = 9 × 5. For 5 it must end in 0 (it cannot end in 5). For 9 it needs nine 1s. The smallest such number is nine 1s followed by a 0: 1,111,111,110.
questionHi: केवल अंकों 0 और 1 से लिखी वह सबसे छोटी धनात्मक संख्या कौन-सी है जो 45 से विभाज्य हो?

subject: Maths
question: What is the smallest three-digit multiple of 11 whose digits are all odd?
solution: In a three-digit multiple of 11 the middle digit is the sum of the outer two, or that sum minus 11. With odd outer digits the sum is even, so the middle digit is odd only in the second case: (a + c) − 11. The smallest such number is 319 = 11 × 29 (3 + 9 − 11 = 1).
questionHi: 11 का वह सबसे छोटा तीन अंकों का गुणज कौन-सा है जिसके सभी अंक विषम हों?
solutionHi: तीन अंकों के 11 के गुणज में बीच का अंक बाहरी दोनों का योग होता है, या वह योग − 11। बाहरी अंक विषम हों तो योग सम, अतः बीच वाला विषम केवल दूसरी स्थिति में: (a + c) − 11। ऐसी सबसे छोटी संख्या 319 = 11 × 29 (3 + 9 − 11 = 1)।

subject: Maths
question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 200 is n² + n + 1 divisible by 13?
solution: Checking remainders 0 to 12, n² + n + 1 is a multiple of 13 only when n leaves 3 (9 + 3 + 1 = 13) or 9 (81 + 9 + 1 = 91 = 7 × 13). From 1 to 200: 3, 16, ..., 198 (16 numbers) and 9, 22, ..., 191 (15 numbers). Total 31.
questionHi: 1 से 200 तक कितनी प्राकृत संख्याओं n के लिए n² + n + 1, 13 से विभाज्य है?

question: For how many natural numbers n from 1 to 100 is 2ⁿ + 3 divisible by 5?
solution: 2ⁿ + 3 is a multiple of 5 when 2ⁿ leaves 2. Powers of 2 leave 2, 4, 3, 1 in turn, so this happens for n = 1, 5, 9, ..., 97: 25 values.

question: Which of 148,296, 371,642, 482,713 and 593,824 is divisible by 37?
solution: 1,000 = 27 × 37 + 1 leaves 1 on division by 37, so a number leaves the same as the sum of its three-digit blocks. 148 + 296 = 444 = 12 × 37, so 148,296 is divisible by 37. The others give 1,013, 1,195 and 1,417, none a multiple of 37.

question: The number 123456789101112...2930 is formed by writing the numbers 1 to 30 one after another. By which of the following is it divisible?
solution: Its digit sum leaves the same as 1 + 2 + ... + 30 = 465 on division by 9: 465 leaves 6, so it is divisible by 3 but not by 9. It ends in 30, not a multiple of 4. On division by 11 it leaves 7, so not by 11.

question: What is the sum of all three-digit numbers whose digits are all odd and which are divisible by 5?
solution: The last digit must be 5 (odd and divisible by 5); the first two digits are any odd digits: 25 numbers. Each odd digit appears 5 times in the hundreds and 5 times in the tens place, so the sum is 100 × 125 + 10 × 125 + 25 × 5 = 12,500 + 1,250 + 125 = 13,875.

solution: 15 = 3 × 5. 60! has 20 + 6 + 2 = 28 threes but only 12 + 2 = 14 fives. The fives run out first, so 15¹⁴.

question: A number is written using only the digit 3 (33, 333, 3333, ...). What is the smallest number of 3s for it to be divisible by 7?
solution: 333...3 = 3 × 111...1, and 7 does not divide 3, so 7 must divide 111...1. The first such is 111,111 = 7 × 15,873. So 6 threes (333,333 = 7 × 47,619).

question: How many numbers from 1 to 1,000 are divisible by 3 but by neither 6 nor 9?
solution: Not divisible by 6 means odd: odd multiples of 3 are 333 − 166 = 167. Of these, the odd multiples of 9 must go: 111 − 55 = 56. So 167 − 56 = 111.

question: For every prime p greater than 5, p⁴ − 1 is divisible by:
solution: p⁴ − 1 = (p − 1)(p + 1)(p² + 1). With p odd, (p − 1)(p + 1) is a multiple of 8 and p² + 1 is even: 16. One of p − 1, p, p + 1 is a multiple of 3, and p is not: 3. By Fermat p⁴ leaves 1 on division by 5: 5. So 16 × 3 × 5 = 240. 7⁴ − 1 = 2,400 is not divisible by 360 or 720, and 11⁴ − 1 = 14,640 not by 480.

question: The product of any five consecutive natural numbers is always divisible by:
solution: Among five consecutive numbers there is a multiple of 5, one of 4, another even number, and a multiple of 3, so the product is divisible by 5! = 120. For 1 × 2 × 3 × 4 × 5 = 120 itself, 240, 360 and 720 do not divide.

question: For how many two-digit numbers n does n² end in the two digits of n itself?
solution: We need n² − n = n(n − 1) to be divisible by 100 = 4 × 25. n and n − 1 share no factor, so one is a multiple of 25 and one of 4 (or one of 100). Two-digit options: n = 25 (n − 1 = 24) and n = 76 (n = 4 × 19, n − 1 = 75). So 2 numbers: 25² = 625, 76² = 5,776.

question: How many three-digit numbers whose digits are in strictly increasing order (like 147) are divisible by 5?

question: How many four-digit numbers with all digits different are divisible by 25?
solution: The last two digits are 25, 50 or 75 (00 repeats a digit). Ending 50: the first two digits come from the other 8 digits, none of them 0: 8 × 7 = 56. Ending 25 or 75: the first digit is non-zero and not used (7 ways), the second any unused digit (7 ways): 49 each. Total 56 + 49 + 49 = 154.

solution: For 11 the alternate sums must differ by 0 or 11; with total 20 they must be 10 and 10 (a difference of 11 would make the total odd). question: For every natural number n, 8ⁿ + 6 is divisible by:
solution: 8 leaves 1 on division by 7, so 8ⁿ + 6 leaves 1 + 6 = 7 → 0: divisible by 7. It is also even, so divisible by 14. For n = 1 it is 14 itself, so 28, 21 and 9 do not always divide it.

question: How many five-digit numbers that read the same backwards (like 13,531) are divisible by 11?
solution: For abcba the alternate sums are (a + c + a) and (b + b), so 2a + c − 2b must be a multiple of 11, i.e. c is fixed by a and b: c = 2(b − a) reduced into 0 to 10. There are 9 × 10 = 90 choices of (a, b); the choice fails only when that c would be 10, i.e. b − a = 5 or −6: 4 + 4 = 8 cases. So 90 − 8 = 82.

solutionHi: abcba के एकांतर योग (a + c + a) और (b + b), अतः 2a + c − 2b, 11 का गुणज हो, यानी c, a और b से तय: c = 2(b − a) को 0 से 10 में लाकर। (a, b) के 9 × 10 = 90 चयन; विफल केवल तब जब c = 10 आए, यानी b − a = 5 या −6: 4 + 4 = 8 स्थितियाँ। अतः 90 − 8 = 82।
